question: The Nizam Shahi dynasty of Ahmednagar was founded by ________ in 1490.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Malik Ahmed Nizamul Mulk Bahri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Malik Ahmed Nizamul Mulk Bahri** was the founder of the Nizam Shahi dynasty in Ahmednagar in the year **1490 CE**.
 
• He was previously a general in the service of the Bahmani Sultanate before establishing his independent rule in the Deccan region.
 
• The establishment of the Nizam Shahi dynasty marked the decline of the Bahmani Sultanate and the emergence of new independent states in the Deccan.
 
• Ahmednagar, the capital of the Nizam Shahi dynasty, became a significant center of administration, culture, and military power under his rule.
 
• The dynasty played a crucial role in the political history of the Deccan, resisting the Mughal expansion during its later years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bahmani Sultanate:**

 
 
• The Bahmani Sultanate (1347–1527 CE) was a major Islamic kingdom in South India, from which the Nizam Shahi dynasty originated.
 
• It eventually fragmented into five independent successor states, including the Nizam Shahi dynasty of Ahmednagar.
 
 
 
• **Deccan Sultanates:**
 
 
• The Nizam Shahi dynasty was one of the five Deccan Sultanates, alongside Bijapur, Golconda, Bidar, and Berar.
 
• These sultanates were known for their rich cultural contributions, including architecture, literature, and art.
 
 
 
• **Ahmednagar Fort:**
 
 
• Ahmednagar Fort, built by Malik Ahmed, is a prominent landmark and served as the stronghold of the dynasty.
 
• The fort later played a role in Indian history during the British colonial period.
 
 
 
• **Decline of the Nizam Shahi dynasty:**
 
 
• The dynasty eventually succumbed to the pressure of Mughal expansion under Emperor Akbar and later Shah Jahan.
 
• It was annexed by the Mughal Empire in 1636 CE, marking the end of its independent rule.
